hypotheses: EX527 at 10 uM for 24 h in A375 may produce a histone-mark perturbation profile most similar to epigenetic-modifier donors, especially G9a/GLP inhibitor BIX-01294, because the anchor profile is dominated by H3K27me1K36me3 and related H3K27/K36 methylation marks.
CPI-169, a PRC2/EZH2 inhibitor, may transfer a target-minus-A375 response that overlaps the EX527 anchor because EZH2 inhibition can alter H3K27 methylation states.
GSK525762A, a BET bromodomain inhibitor, may be relevant because BET inhibition can indirectly perturb histone acetylation/methylation readouts and chromatin-associated transcriptional programs.
UNC1215, an L3MBTL1/2/3 methyl-lysine reader antagonist, may be relevant because it directly targets chromatin reader domains that interpret H3K27/K36 methylation marks.
CHIR99021, a GSK3 inhibitor, may be relevant as a signaling-to-chromatin perturbation candidate because kinase inhibition can indirectly remodel histone modification patterns.
object.evidence_gap: No direct measured histone-mark response values for EX527 in A375 are provided; donor selection is based on anchor-profile similarity, chromatin pharmacology, and the need to retrieve donor descriptions before any transfer. The PubChem description only confirms EX527 is a chlorinated tetrahydrocarbazole carboxamide and does not establish a histone-modifying mechanism.
